extension.description: Add any number of Stremio addon manifests and browse their catalogs, metadata, streams and subtitles from inside Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on provides no content. You are responsible for the Stremio addons you install and the content they provide.
extension.news: v0.16.3 - Continue Watching lists one episode per show, the one you played last (the others keep their place). A show you remove from it stays off until you play one of its episodes again. v0.16.2 - Subtitles: when the subtitle addons have none as a video starts (AIOStreams can answer empty when it's slow), they're asked again a few seconds in and added to the video, so a film whose own subtitles are pictures (Blu-ray PGS, which ignore Kodi's font and colour) gets text subtitles in your style. v0.16.1 - Fixes MDBList saying the API key was rejected after 0.16.0: requests now identify themselves, so they aren't blocked, and a blocked request is no longer reported as a bad key.
